leftEvidence.title: The beloved-Son voice is heard on the mountain

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Jesus is transfigured before Peter, James, and John; Moses and Elijah appear, and a bright cloud overshadows them.
points.right: Peter denies following myths and describes being an eyewitness of Jesus’ majesty.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: A voice names Jesus as beloved Son, adds divine pleasure, and commands the disciples to listen to him.
points.right: He recalls honor and glory from the Father, the beloved-Son declaration, and the voice heard on the holy mountain.

payload.posture: Matthew narrates the scene and 2 Peter claims remembered hearing of the majestic voice.

rightEvidence.title: Peter remembers hearing the majestic voice

payload.tension: The later witness uses the shared beloved-Son language while locating it specifically on the holy mountain.
payload.title: The mountain scene and an eyewitness memory
